user.title: Outdoor Brief
user.description:
The daily outdoor brief: tides for now, then marine weather, moon and garden in later versions. All tide data comes from the Marées France integration (SHOM), installed separately: Outdoor Brief never fetches it from the Internet itself.

Version 0.1 offers the coastal profile only. The garden profile (frost, rain, moon phase) comes in 0.5.

data_description.profile: What the brief is about. Garden and Both will appear here in a later version.

port.title: Port
port.description: Choose the Marées France port (one port = one Marées France device). Add another Outdoor Brief entry for each extra port.

data_description.port_device_id: Only devices created by the Marées France integration are listed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: These settings can be changed later from the integration options.

data.pressure_entity: Pressure sensor for the storm surge (optional)

data_description.spring_tide_threshold: A day counts as a spring tide when its highest coefficient reaches this value. 100 is the usual convention; lower it to be told about strong tides more often (December 2026 peaks at 99, for example).
data_description.admin_notify_target: A notify.mobile_app_* service or a notify entity from the Companion app. Pre-filled with the phone already chosen in another SDR integration, if any. Used for notifications from version 0.3.
data_description.fishing_coefficient: A shore fishing window surrounds a low tide whose coefficient reaches this value: from 2 hours before low water to 1 hour after. 70 is a common minimum; 90 and above uncover the most ground.
data_description.fishing_daylight_only: Only keep windows whose low tide falls between sunrise and sunset (at the Home Assistant location).
data_description.pressure_entity: A local pressure sensor or a weather entity. The storm surge is estimated from the inverse barometer effect: about 1 cm of water per hPa below 1013 hPa, wind not included. Empty: Open-Meteo's pressure is used if enabled, otherwise no surge entity.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description:
Phone notifications use the admin phone chosen in the previous screen; the daily brief carries the summary image. The watch is optional and independent from the phone.

Apple Watch: iPhone notifications already show on the watch, leave the watch off to avoid duplicates. Wear OS: choose the watch's own notify service.

data_description.notify_frequency: Every day, only on remarkable days (today's coefficient reaches the spring tide threshold, or a spring tide within 2 days), or never. The spring tide alert (2 days before) is sent unless set to never.
data_description.notify_time: Time of the daily brief (Home Assistant time zone).
data_description.image_theme: Colours of the summary image attached to the phone notification.
data_description.watch_mode: Off; full notification (same text, no image, sent even without a phone); or short notice, sent only when the phone notification went through.
data_description.watch_notify_target: A notify service or entity of the watch, e.g. notify.mobile_app_galaxy_watch.
data_description.notify_grouping: Own notification for this port, or one notification grouping every port set to « grouped ». The grouped notification follows the settings (time, frequency, phone, watch) of the oldest grouped port; the others only add their tides.
data_description.tap_url: Dashboard path opened when tapping the notification. Empty: the Outdoor Brief dashboard (/outdoor-brief), which shows the same report live.
data_description.message_style: Short: only coefficients and next tide, when the summary image is attached (the image carries the details). Detailed: every tide in the text. A target that cannot receive the image (Telegram, ntfy, e-mail…) always gets the detailed text.
data_description.extra_notify_targets: Other phones or channels: any notify service or entity (another Companion phone, Telegram, Signal, ntfy, Gotify, e-mail…). Companion phones receive the image; other channels receive the title and detailed text.

marine.title: Sea conditions (Open-Meteo)
marine.description: Optional online service. Disabled, Outdoor Brief makes no Internet request at all. Enabled, it reads the waves, swell and water temperature every hour from Open-Meteo (free, no account, data under CC BY 4.0) for the point chosen below, and the sea-level pressure for the storm surge.

data_description.marine_enabled: Creates the wave, swell and water temperature entities. Disabling removes them.
data_description.marine_location: Pick a point just off the coast: wave models do not cover inland areas or narrow estuaries. Defaults to the Home Assistant location.

error.invalid_target: Enter a notify service or entity, e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone.
error.watch_target_required: Choose the watch's notify target, or set the watch to Off.
error.invalid_tap_url: Enter a path starting with /, e.g. /lovelace/0.
error.invalid_extra_target: Each recipient must be a notify service or entity, e.g. notify.telegram.
error.marine_unreachable: Open-Meteo did not answer. Check the Internet connection, or disable this option.
error.marine_no_data: Open-Meteo has no wave data for this point: move it further out to sea.

abort.marees_france_missing: Outdoor Brief reads tides from the Marées France integration. Install it (HACS or Marketplace) and add at least one port first.

send_summary.name: Send the brief now
send_summary.description: Sends the daily brief right away to the phone (and watch), ignoring the frequency. Useful to test notifications.

config_entry_id.name: Outdoor Brief entry
config_entry_id.description: Leave empty to send the brief of every port.
